visual_action: The video opens with a close-up of Bernie Sanders speaking animatedly at a podium. It then cuts to a composite image showing a shirtless man, identified by text as Graham Platner, in an indoor setting. An arrow points from an inset box to a tattoo on the man's chest. The inset box displays a skull-and-crossbones image labeled 'Hate on Display / Totenkopf' and 'Neo-Nazi Symbols'. The video is watermarked 'CROOKED'.

cast.name: Bernie Sanders
cast.evidence: Appears on screen at the beginning of the video, speaking at a podium. He is identified by face recognition.

cast.name: Graham Platner
cast.evidence: He is named in a large text overlay ('GRAHAM PLATNER') and is the subject of the video, which focuses on his tattoo. Bernie Sanders also says his name at the beginning.

cast.name: Crooked Media
cast.evidence: The word 'CROOKED' appears as a watermark in the top right corner of the clip featuring Graham Platner.

on_screen_text.text:

spoken_summary: Bernie Sanders says a name, "Graham Platner," which is then visually identified in the following clip.
audio_music: The video starts with only Bernie Sanders speaking. After he says the name, a slow, somber, slide-guitar-like instrumental track begins and plays for the remainder of the video, creating a serious and damning tone. The fingerprinted track is identified as 'Coochie God (feat. LIL Rape)' by Poortray, LIL Rape.
editing_pacing: A single, sharp cut from a talking-head shot of Bernie Sanders to a static composite image that identifies and explains the significance of Graham Platner's tattoo.
central_claim: Graham Platner, a person identified by Bernie Sanders, has a tattoo that is a recognized Neo-Nazi symbol.
intended_effect: To discredit Graham Platner by associating him with Nazism and to provoke disgust in the viewer.
uncertainty_flags: The text on Bernie Sanders' podium is partially obscured but appears to say 'FIGHT OLIGARCHY'.
The fingerprinted song title 'Coochie God (feat. LIL Rape)' seems tonally dissonant with the somber instrumental music heard in the video.
